## Description

Describe the Spring concept this module introduces and what learners should understand after completing it.

---

## Learning Objectives

- [ ] Explain the concept
- [ ] Demonstrate the concept with code
- [ ] Highlight best practices
- [ ] Discuss common pitfalls (if applicable)

---

## Implementation Checklist

- [ ] Create module structure
- [ ] Implement the example
- [ ] Add `AppConfig`
- [ ] Add `Main`
- [ ] Add `AppConfigTest`
- [ ] Write README
- [ ] Verify `mvn clean install`
- [ ] Update `ROADMAP.md`

---

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Example builds successfully
- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] Documentation is complete
- [ ] Module follows repository conventions
